answer: The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The grove assignment is published and gale records each panel. Shards are assigned from the dawn graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3218 identities would post 4825 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
